items.title: Humanoid robot startup LimX Dynamics raises $200M Pre-IPO at $2.1B valuation
items.title_zh: 人形机器人公司逐际动力完成2亿美元Pre-IPO轮融资，估值达150亿元
items.summary: General humanoid robot company LimX Dynamics completed a nearly $200M Pre-IPO round from IDG Capital, Lens Technology, and others, targeting brain-body fusion tech, autonomous deployment of thousands of humanoid robots, and global expansion into the Middle East and Europe.

items.title: Xiaomi humanoid robot achieves first long-duration flexible-part operation in auto factory
items.title_zh: 小米人形机器人首次实现汽车工厂柔性工件长时连续作业
items.summary: Xiaomi's humanoid robot made a breakthrough: self-tapping nut station success rate improved from 90.2% to 98% over 4 months, and two new workstations — center console cover sorting and bin folding — achieved 90% success, marking the first flexible-part long-duration autonomous operation in an auto plant.

items.title: Masayoshi Son: AI will require $5 trillion annual investment by 2040
items.title_zh: 孙正义：到2040年AI每年需要5万亿美元投资
items.summary: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son stated global AI infrastructure will need $5 trillion/year by 2040 to support data centers, power supply, and humanoid robot deployment, driving a shift toward Artificial Super Intelligence (ASI). 'AI will radically change our lives — and that change will generate profits,' Son said.

items.title: PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B
items.title_zh: 视频生成初创公司PixVerse融资4.39亿美元，估值突破20亿
items.summary: Video-generation startup PixVerse raised $439M, pushing its valuation past $2B. The company plans to expand its world model offerings and reach customers across more geographies.

items.title: SK Hynix accelerates Y1 fab construction, begins ordering DRAM manufacturing equipment
items.title_zh: SK海力士加速Y1工厂建设，开始订购DRAM制造设备
items.summary: SK Hynix has begun ordering advanced DRAM manufacturing equipment for its Y1 fab in Yongin, South Korea, targeting 20,000 wafers/month capacity. The first cleanroom started production in February 2026, ahead of the original May 2026 schedule.

items.title: SpaceX gears up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
items.title_zh: SpaceX本周将进行星舰第13次试飞
items.summary: SpaceX is preparing Starship's 13th test flight, subjecting the vehicle to higher pressure than previous flights and testing new Starlink satellites in orbit.

items.title: Unitree Robotics partners with Hunan Steel: embodied AI enters heavy industry
items.title_zh: 宇树机器人与湖南钢铁合作：具身AI正式进入重工业
items.summary: Unitree Robotics, Hunan Steel, and spatial AI company Looper Robotics formed a tripartite alliance to deploy legged robots for steel plant inspection, marking one of the first entries of embodied AI into heavy industry.

items.title: Uber's product chief on hotels, robotaxis, and why the company doesn't want to be 'everything for everyone'
items.title_zh: Uber产品负责人谈酒店、无人驾驶出租车及超级应用战略
items.summary: Uber CPO Sachin Kansal discussed the company's financial-services ambitions, its increasingly complex relationship with Waymo, the new AV Labs data operation, and how AI is starting to show up in ways riders and drivers will notice.

items.title: Gemini in Chrome rolling out to the UK
items.title_zh: Gemini正式集成至Chrome浏览器，已扩展至英国市场
items.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant integration into Chrome continues its gradual global rollout, launching today in the United Kingdom.

items.title: Is x86 ready to ACE it?
items.title_zh: x86架构准备好迎接ACE时代了吗？
items.summary: A deep-dive from Chips and Cheese examines whether x86 architecture is ready for the ACE specification enabling more flexible CPU power management, comparing Intel and AMD implementations. (240 HN points)

items.title: iOS 27 public beta: Should you install it on your iPhone?
items.title_zh: iOS 27公测版发布：是否应该立即升级？
items.summary: The iOS 27 public beta is now available with major new features. 9to5Mac provides a breakdown of what's new and whether early adoption is worth the risk.

items.title: EV sales normalizing in the US but taking off everywhere else
items.title_zh: 美国电动车销售趋于平稳，全球其他市场加速起飞
items.summary: EV sales in the US are normalizing after the loss of the Federal Tax Credit in September 2025, while sales are accelerating globally, with Europe leading the charge.

items.title: The Economics of Recursive Self-Improvement [pdf]
items.title_zh: 递归自我改进的经济学分析
items.summary: A paper from the Elasticity Institute analyzing the economic implications of recursive self-improvement in AI systems, examining feedback loops and potential economic trajectories. (77 HN points)

items.title: MorphoHDL: A minimalistic language for growing circuits
items.title_zh: MorphoHDL：一种用于电路生长的极简硬件描述语言
items.summary: MorphoHDL is a new minimalistic hardware description language designed for 'growing' circuits rather than describing them imperatively, offering a novel approach to chip design. (56 HN points)

items.title: What will be left for us to work on?
items.title_zh: 当AI完成所有工作，人类还剩下什么？
items.summary: An essay exploring what meaningful work remains for humans as AI systems become increasingly capable, examining both economic and philosophical implications. (112 HN points)

items.title: PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B
items.title_zh: 视频生成初创公司PixVerse融资4.39亿美元，估值突破20亿
items.summary: Video-generation startup PixVerse raised $439M, pushing its valuation past $2B. The company plans to expand its world model offerings and reach customers across more geographies.

items.title: SpaceX gears up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
items.title_zh: SpaceX本周将进行星舰第13次试飞
items.summary: SpaceX is preparing Starship's 13th test flight, subjecting the vehicle to higher pressure than previous flights and testing new Starlink satellites in orbit.

items.title: Morning briefing: Hainan bans fuel cars 2030; CXMT employee shares at ¥0.1; SK Hynix plunges 15%; ByteDance explores autonomous driving
items.title_zh: 8点1氪：海南2030年禁售燃油车；长鑫科技员工股低至1毛；SK海力士暴跌15%；字节探索自动驾驶
items.summary: Key headlines: Hainan to become China's first province banning fuel car sales (effective 2030); CXMT reportedly offered employee shares at ¥0.1/share; SK Hynix stock crashed 15%; ByteDance's Seed world model team reportedly exploring autonomous driving; Apple reportedly skipping M6 Pro/Max to focus on AI-oriented M7 series.

items.title: Former Bosch autonomous driving engineer founds startup: synthetic data for tactile foundation models
items.title_zh: 前博世自动驾驶算法工程师创业，用合成数据构建触觉大模型
items.summary: Spatial intelligence startup Dayan Technology, founded by a former Bosch engineer (NUS PhD), completed a multi-million RMB angel round. The company focuses on tactile foundation models via synthetic data, 4D world reconstruction, and controllable diffusion models for robotics.

items.title: ByteDance denies plans to enter smart driving business
items.title_zh: 字节跳动否认进入自动驾驶业务
items.summary: ByteDance denied media reports claiming it was exploring autonomous driving with a focus on driverless logistics, following reports that its Seed world model team was working on the initiative.

items.title: Samsung Electronics reportedly explores ADR issuance in early-stage discussions
items.title_zh: 三星电子初步探讨发行美国存托凭证（ADR）可能性
items.summary: Samsung Electronics is in early-stage discussions with banks about issuing ADRs. The company is closely monitoring the volatile memory chip sector, and its complex business structure plus ongoing labor disputes could complicate any US listing.

items.title: AI enters second half: from DeepSeek to robots — where is AI heading?
items.title_zh: 人工智能进入下半场：从DeepSeek到机器人，AI正在走向哪里？
items.summary: Huxiu analysis on AI's transition from pure language models toward embodied intelligence and robotics, examining the post-DeepSeek landscape and growing convergence of LLMs with physical world interaction.

items.title: China's electric vehicle exports rise 68.7% in H1 2026
items.title_zh: 2026年上半年中国电动汽车出口增长68.7%
items.summary: China's EV exports surged 68.7% YoY in H1 2026. Electric motorcycle and bicycle exports rose 31.5%, electric locomotives 45.1%, lithium batteries 37.6%, and wind turbines 35.6%, according to customs data.

items.title: Large models have abandoned ordinary users
items.title_zh: 大模型已经抛弃了普通用户
items.summary: Huxiu commentary arguing that major AI model providers are increasingly prioritizing enterprise and developer customers over consumer-facing applications, leaving everyday users behind in the AI revolution.

items.title: Scientific Reports study: ChatGPT boosts efficiency but may reduce human motivation
items.title_zh: 《科学报告》：ChatGPT提高工作效率但可能降低人类内在动力
items.summary: A study published in Scientific Reports found that collaborating with ChatGPT improves work efficiency but may simultaneously reduce intrinsic motivation, revealing a double-edged sword effect in human-AI collaboration.

items.title: Lianxun Instruments raises registered capital to ¥103M for semiconductor equipment
items.title_zh: 联讯仪器增资至1.03亿元，加码半导体设备制造
items.summary: Suzhou Lianxun Instruments increased its registered capital from ¥77M to ¥103M. The company produces semiconductor device manufacturing equipment, optical instruments, electronic measurement instruments, and 5G communication testing tools.

items.title: South Korea convenes emergency meeting on leveraged semiconductor ETF crash
items.title_zh: 韩国政府紧急召集四部门会议应对半导体杠杆ETF暴跌
items.summary: South Korea's top four economic agencies will meet Thursday to address leveraged ETFs tracking Samsung and SK Hynix that have nearly halved in value since May 2026 — the first time this issue has reached the country's highest economic coordination platform.

items.title: Swiss competition authority investigates Google over Android search default removal
items.title_zh: 瑞士竞争监管机构就安卓移除搜索选择功能调查谷歌
items.summary: Switzerland's COMCO opened a preliminary investigation into Google for removing Android's search engine choice screen, forcing Google Search as the mandatory default on Swiss devices. The choice screen remains active in the European Economic Area.

items.title: Traditional CIOs being fired en masse: IT leadership crisis in the AI era
items.title_zh: 今年大量传统CIO被裁：AI时代的IT领导力危机
items.summary: Huxiu reports a wave of traditional CIO dismissals in 2026 as companies restructure IT leadership to prioritize AI-native capabilities, with legacy CIOs lacking AI expertise being replaced.

items.title: Agent era day 500: why we should stop investing in GUI-thinking software
items.title_zh: Agent元年500天：为什么我们不该再投资GUI思维的软件
items.summary: A 500-day retrospective on the AI agent era examining the paradigm shift away from GUI-centric software toward agent-native architectures and interaction models.

items.title: First AI agent phone launches: three key questions from a VC perspective
items.title_zh: 首款智能体手机面世：VC视角下的三个关键问题
items.summary: VC analysis of the first AI agent smartphone launch, examining three critical questions: product-market fit, competitive moat, and monetization model for agent-native phones.

items.title: ZTE Nubia vs StepFun: AI agent smartphone showdown heats up
items.title_zh: 中兴努比亚vs阶跃星辰：智能体手机大战正式开启
items.summary: Nubia debuted the world's first AI agent phone at WAIC, while StepFun launched the STEPX Neo with Step AOS and the Amoo agent, marking the official start of the agent phone era with competing hardware and OS visions.

items.title: QuestMobile 2026 H1 AI app report: AI-native apps see MAU and engagement surge, Agent+Skill disrupts traditional apps
items.title_zh: QuestMobile H1报告：AI原生APP月活与黏性双增长，Agent+Skill击穿传统APP
items.summary: QuestMobile's H1 2026 report shows AI-native mobile apps achieving strong growth in both monthly active users and engagement time, with Agent + Skill architectures beginning to disrupt traditional app ecosystems.

items.title: LibTV major upgrade: complete AI video from a single sentence
items.title_zh: LibTV重大升级：一句话即可生成完整视频
items.summary: LibTV announced a major upgrade enabling users to create complete video productions from a single natural language prompt, democratizing professional video creation with AI.

items.title: Why Huawei insists on not building cars: the answer lies in Seres
items.title_zh: 华为为何坚持不造车？答案藏在赛力斯里
items.summary: Analysis of Huawei's strategic decision to remain a Tier-1 supplier and technology partner rather than a direct car manufacturer, with the Seres partnership serving as the blueprint for its automotive strategy.

items.title: AI enters heavy industry era: how to monetize trillion-scale computing infrastructure?
items.title_zh: AI进入重工业时代：万亿算力基建如何赚钱？
items.summary: Huxiu analysis on the business model challenges of the massive AI infrastructure buildout, examining how companies plan to generate returns on trillion-yuan scale investments in computing power.

items.title: Yin Qi's transformation: StepFun's strategic pivot before IPO
items.title_zh: 印奇蜕变：阶跃星辰IPO前的战略转身
items.summary: Profile of StepFun founder Yin Qi and the company's strategic pivot ahead of its planned IPO, repositioning from a pure AI model provider to an integrated AI agent platform.

items.title: Doubao vs WorkBuddy vs QoderWork: 8 real office tasks benchmark three desktop AI agents
items.title_zh: 豆包、WorkBuddy、QoderWork横向对比：8个真实办公任务实测三大桌面Agent
items.summary: Hands-on comparison of ByteDance's Doubao, WorkBuddy, and QoderWork across eight real-world office productivity tasks, benchmarking the capabilities of three leading desktop AI agents.

items.title: NVIDIA's supply chain begins to worry about AI demand sustainability
items.title_zh: 英伟达背后的供应商也开始担忧AI需求持续性
items.summary: Analysis of growing concerns among NVIDIA's key suppliers and the broader semiconductor supply chain about the sustainability of current AI-driven demand growth.

items.title: China breaks world record: perovskite-organic tandem solar cell achieves 28.04% steady-state efficiency
items.title_zh: 中国刷新世界纪录：钙钛矿-有机叠层太阳能电池效率达28.04%
items.summary: The CAS Institute of Chemistry achieved a certified 28.04% steady-state efficiency in perovskite-organic tandem solar cells using a full-phase regulation strategy, published in Nature.

items.title: OpenAI's latest whistleblower: power struggles, existential risk, and the 2040 plan
items.title_zh: OpenAI最新吹哨人：权力博弈、生存性风险与2040计划
items.summary: A new OpenAI whistleblower account detailing internal power struggles, the company's trajectory toward AGI, and what is described as a '2040 plan' addressing existential risks from advanced AI systems.

items.title: CyberCab hits the road: the final chapter of human-driven transportation
items.title_zh: CyberCab上路：人类出行历史走到最后一程
items.summary: Commentary on Tesla's CyberCab autonomous taxi hitting public roads, framed as a historic milestone marking the transition from human-driven to autonomous transportation.
